scope: Bounded source/input adoption only; eleven audit groups receive selected subsets, not full-group/chapter completion

REQ-MIDI-EDIT-001: Empty Session slot on a MIDI track; double-click or Insert Empty MIDI Clip(s). In Arrangement select an empty timespan on a MIDI track and invoke the same command.
Create a MIDI clip in that location. Initial length for double-click, defaults and occupied/audio-slot behavior remain U.
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-002: Focused Notes editor; toggle Draw Mode with B; click empty grid, then existing note. In inactive Draw Mode double-click empty grid or an existing note.

Draw adds notes; clicking an existing note in Draw Mode deletes it. Outside Draw Mode double-click adds or deletes respectively. Pitch-lock preference confines a draw gesture to one pitch; Alt/Option temporarily reverses pitch-lock behavior.
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-005: Drag selected note or resize edge with grid on; toggle grid off or use the temporary grid modifier.

Movement is initially free until a grid/offset point, then snaps; original grid offset can be retained. Modifier temporarily reverses grid-enabled state. Snap thresholds, ties and zoom-dependent grid choice U.
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-006: Select notes, drag or use arrows; paste clipboard notes at insert marker; place a same-pitch new note over an old note.

Horizontal movement changes time; vertical movement changes pitch. Paste begins at insert marker. A new note overlapping the old note start replaces the old note; overlap limited to the old note end shortens the old note. Exact touching-edge and expression collision results U.
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-009: Select notes and invoke Deactivate or 0, then 0 again. Edit notes imported from a MIDI file and invoke Undo.

Deactivated notes are muted/grayed; second toggle reactivates. Undo permits return to prior clip state. Editing imported MIDI leaves original file bytes unchanged. Undo grouping for gestures and persistence of history U.
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-014: Invoke Randomize with selected notes or none; set Velocity Deviation on a note.

Randomize changes selected velocities or all notes if none selected, within the stated amount relative to originals. Deviation is a playback-time range; velocity 60 with +20 yields values in 60..80. Double-click a deviated marker resets deviation to zero. Random distribution/seed/repeatability U.

REQ-MIDI-EDIT-001: Empty Session slot on a MIDI track; double-click or Insert Empty MIDI Clip(s). In Arrangement select an empty timespan on a MIDI track and invoke the same command. Explicit remaining entries are Create > Insert Empty MIDI Clip(s) on an empty Session slot, Arrangement track-display double-click, and CtrlShiftM Win/CmdShiftM Mac on an empty Arrangement MIDI timespan.
Create a MIDI clip in that location. Initial length for double-click, defaults and occupied/audio-slot behavior remain U.
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-002: Focused Notes editor; toggle Draw Mode with B; click empty grid, then existing note. In inactive Draw Mode double-click empty grid or an existing note. Explicit Draw entries are Control Bar button and focused B; Pitch Lock preference state is declared.

Draw adds notes; clicking an existing note in Draw Mode deletes it. Outside Draw Mode double-click adds or deletes respectively. Pitch-lock preference confines a draw gesture to one pitch; Alt/Option temporarily reverses pitch-lock behavior. With Pitch Lock OFF drawing is melodic and Alt Win/Option Mac temporarily enables pitch lock. Melodic overdraw erases an existing note; pitch-locked backtracking erases drawn notes. Focused Options/context labels state Draw Mode (Pitch Lock On/Off).
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-005: Drag selected note or resize edge with grid on; toggle grid off or use the temporary grid modifier. Exact grid entry controls include Grid Settings button, Options Snap to Grid and Ctrl4 Win/Cmd4 Mac.

Movement is initially free until a grid/offset point, then snaps; original grid offset can be retained. Modifier temporarily reverses grid-enabled state. Snap thresholds, ties and zoom-dependent grid choice U.
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-006: Select notes, drag or use arrows; paste clipboard notes at insert marker; place a same-pitch new note over an old note. Copy-drag uses Ctrl Win/Option Mac, including introducing the modifier after a drag starts.

Horizontal movement changes time; vertical movement changes pitch. Paste begins at insert marker. A new note overlapping the old note start replaces the old note; overlap limited to the old note end shortens the old note. Exact touching-edge and expression collision results U. The admitted modifier drag makes copies at the destination; exact identities and collisions U.
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-009: Select notes and invoke Deactivate or 0, then 0 again. Edit notes imported from a MIDI file and invoke Undo. Deactivate Note(s) entries include Edit menu, piano-ruler context and MIDI Note Editor context.

Deactivated notes are muted/grayed; second toggle reactivates. Undo permits return to prior clip state. Editing imported MIDI leaves original file bytes unchanged. Undo grouping for gestures and persistence of history U.
REQ-MIDI-EDIT-014: Invoke Randomize with selected notes or none; set Velocity Deviation on a note. Randomize can target selected notes or selected markers; validating a typed Randomization Amount with Enter is a separate entry.

Randomize changes selected velocities or all notes if none selected, within the stated amount relative to originals. Deviation is a playback-time range; velocity 60 with +20 yields values in 60..80. Double-click a deviated marker resets deviation to zero. Random distribution/seed/repeatability U. Validating the typed amount with Enter triggers randomization; no guaranteed changed realization follows.

new_cases.kind: Grid entry routes and original offset
new_cases.setup_action: Use separate disposable owned valid nonempty MIDI clips with distinct identifiable interior notes, admitted ordinary edit controls and exact reset copies. Record editor/tab/focus, foreground, platform, grid, DrawMode, PitchLock, scale, note/time/loop selection and transport histories explicitly. Establish genuinely productive matched operation before a no-effect/exclusion/erase or other negative comparison; a flag, empty clip, unsupported control or failed positive stays U. Independently accept symbolic values in the actual editor; source/note-storage domains do not prove UI admission. Pure editor-data probes need no instrument, audio, MIDI hardware or vendor execution; audible operations would need separate productive nonzero output. No files/media/instrument/original result are supplied here. On independently reset copies set a declared grid and a known nonzero original note offset relative to it, well away from clip edges. Establish ordinary note drag plus working grid on/off first. Use Grid Settings button, Options Snap to Grid and Ctrl4 Win/Cmd4 Mac separately to disable/enable; retain actual switch state and drag note. In separate enabled/disabled resets use literal Alt Win/Cmd Mac during drag. Independently identify the original offset, then drag across several visible grid encounters, retaining grid-relative position. Missing known offset or productive drag is U.
new_cases.expected: Named entry controls toggle/bypass grid, temporary modifier reverses enabled state, and snapping can preserve the note's original grid-relative offset.
new_cases.comparator: Compare only offered grid controls/states and source-described original-offset retention in the admitted history. No grid spacing formula, snap threshold, first-encounter distance, ties, offset codec or pixel/sensitivity oracle.
